searches.finding: dev/build.sh builds an example with -mcpu=mosw65816 +mos-a16 only when its source contains the string 'mos-a16-only'. Twenty-odd far-pointer demos carry it (farspill.c, farptrcmp.c, bankwalk.c, lzss-gallery.c, julia.c, ...). examples/snes/ascast.c and examples/snes/corpus/ascast_sim.c do not; the far type is spelled in examples/65816/ascast.h (AS_FAR = address_space(2)).
docs/defects/mos-far-pointer-arg-exhaustion.json records the same 'unable to legalize G_MERGE_VALUES s32' in plain mosw65816 and calls it the existing plain-mode limit; no record owns that limit.

docs/investigations/2026-09-24-mos24-far-addressing-completeness-audit.md: far storage under default 8-bit is deliberately deferred and re-verified (18/26 far fixtures fail cleanly). Demo comments state the contract: 'A far pointer is a 32-bit value => +mos-a16-only (default-8bit legitimately can't ...)'.

searches.finding: 083d8d00 (2026-09-28, Add Round 8 Cluster D compiler demos) added ascast with no marker. Its plan, docs/plans/2026-09-28-round8-cluster-d-abi-and-memory-widths.md, says the far path is checked in +mos-a16 only; dev/round8d-demo.sh sets MODES=(a16) for ascast; examples/snes/corpus/expected.tsv omits ascast_sim. Only dev/build.sh, which reads the marker, builds it in default mode.

G_ADDRSPACE_CAST is customForCartesianProduct({P, PZ, PF, PFP}) in every mode (the #320 near-to-far zero-extension), while G_MERGE_VALUES {S32,S8}/{S32,S16} is custom/legal only under hasAccum16(). In default mode the cast's s32 merge is therefore unsupported.
Only the TODO ranking commits (ac5d2982, 069c9fe9). No repair.

earlier_sightings.detail: Step 6: ascast and ascast_sim precodegen.bc fail identically on baseline and candidate llc with 'unable to legalize ... G_MERGE_VALUES ... (in function: ac_to_far)'; the plan notes that ascast.c was then untracked work of another agent.
The originating report: fails with the pre-0071 clang-23 254624ba and with clang-23 e532fbee.

upstream: Upstream llvm-mos has no far address space: /opt/llvm-mos (0f031168a7cc) fails earlier on the same input with 'unable to legalize ... G_LOAD %6:_(p2)' in ac_read on mosw65816 and mos6502 (runs/upstream-opt-llvm-mos), as does the split-series base p-321-00 and the #321 top r7-321-16. The #320 top r7-320-4 and the far-word top r7-fw-12 fail exactly as downstream, so the default-mode behaviour is defined by the upstream-bound #320 series.
conclusion: The battery failure is a demo build-contract omission (no mos-a16-only marker); with the marker's flags both programs link on every tested toolchain. The compiler behaviour itself, a fatal legalizer error instead of a diagnostic or a legal lowering for near-to-far casts without +mos-a16, has no canonical record; it is recorded here as a contract clarification because the repository documents default-mode far pointers as unsupported but has not decided what the compiler should do with them.
